title: Deeper/broader open-source DWG/DXF route coverage closure and evidence ceilings
mode: primary-source web research and read-only plan reconciliation
scope: Screen open-source DWG/DXF codec, wrapper, and ACIS/B-rep projects not yet represented in the active peer matrix
Classify implementation lineage and exact route boundaries from project-owned sources
Reduce implementation blocking by stating a stop rule for further peer discovery and optional runs

method.kind: Read current project-owned repository documentation and reconcile with existing plan entries
method.limitations: Repository pages are mutable and were not tied to immutable source commits or executed. Descriptions establish route classification only; no peer behavior, conformance, native acceptance, or semantic support is reproduced by this pass. Existing entries for most projects were cross-reconciled rather than re-audited in code.

sources.observed: The project documents DWG through LibreDWG FFI and DXF through the separate pure-Rust undxf crate; it is read-only and does not convert between DWG and DXF.
sources.limits: Application/model behavior was not executed; DWG evidence remains LibreDWG lineage and DXF evidence remains the separately tracked undxf route.

sources.observed: The documentation identifies LibreDWG as the optional open-source DWG route and a distinct proprietary alternative; the latter describes only partial SAB wireframe/bounds fallback, not full B-rep tessellation.
sources.limits: No parser or application was run. The proprietary route is not an open-source peer and its documented projection is not semantic solid evidence.

sources.revision: Mutable main pages accessed 2026-10-20; immutable commit not resolved
sources.observed: The repository labels itself a pre-alpha ODA-spec v5.4.1 Rust reader, distinguishes a more mature container/object walker from partial typed decoding, publishes per-version decoded/skipped/error counts over a small corpus, has no DXF parser, and lists a 3DSOLID bounding-box placeholder. No ACIS/B-rep route is documented in the reviewed README.
sources.limits: No peer build or execution, source code audit, corpus audit, ACIS profile test, or expected-value comparison was performed. It remains a possible exact-question structural comparator only.

sources.observed: The public project description identifies the repository as a fork of libdxfrw.
sources.limits: No source diff or runtime was reviewed; same-family status is sufficient to exclude it as an independent parser vote.

sources.observed: The detailed ACIS SAT/SAB matrix leaves both read and write unchecked despite a broad multi-format README summary.
sources.limits: No source implementation or runtime audit was performed; no ACIS reader is admitted from the project-level feature list.

sources.observed: The preview repository directs users to separately obtained commercial extensions and lists ACIS SAT/SAB exchange among those components, distinct from the open-source OCCT core.
sources.limits: No component was acquired, licensed, installed, or executed. This classifies availability, not runtime capability.

sources.observed: Existing plan entries already bound these candidates to limited bare-carrier profiles, shared OCCT kernel use for cq-acis, and disclosed CADMPEG/ezdxf format references.
sources.limits: No new artifacts were run; the existing profile, lineage, and evidence ceilings remain unchanged.

assessment.disposition: No newly surfaced project covers the full DWG container, modern AcDs owner/key association, ACIS B-rep semantics, independent geometry validation, and native Linux/Windows acceptance chain. Keep existing peer roles. Continue local spec-backed work without waiting for broad peer discovery. Admit at most one exact-pinned peer at the existing composed checkpoint for a named unresolved question; otherwise record NOT_RUN and return to the local queue. All six J items remain DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
